stemMd: How many distinct bit patterns can be represented by 5 bits?
explanationMd: Each bit has two possible values independently. Five positions therefore give 2 to the fifth=32 patterns, including the all-zero pattern.

distractorRationale.e: This is the number for 6 bits.
distractorRationale.a: This counts positions rather than patterns.
distractorRationale.b: Each position doubles the total, not adds two.
distractorRationale.c: This squares the bit count rather than raising 2 to it.
